# Temper Tantrums

> Temper Tantrums is a café and wine bar at 94 Wimpole Street, Marylebone, London W1G 0EH (opened 30 September 2026). Café by day — coffee, cornetti, breakfast bruschetta; wine & cocktail bar by night — serious wines, exceptional cocktails and Italian small plates with Asian accents (cicchetti, pinsa romana, pasta, salumi). From the team behind the Temper restaurants. Brand voice: "irreverent elegance with a taste for mischief."

## Pages
- [Home](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/): overview, café by day / wine & cocktails by night
- [Menus](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/menu/): full café, lunch cicchetti and dinner menus with prices
- [Sunday Bottomless Brunch](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/brunch/): every Sunday from 12pm, three courses + 90 minutes bottomless drinks, £40pp
- [Private Hire & Events](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/events/): venue hire enquiries for birthdays, launches and parties
- [The Space](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/space/): the interior — chandeliers, collected mirrors, rock and roll portraits
- [Christmas Parties](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/christmas/): Christmas party bookings and group takeovers for December 2026
- [Find Us](https://tempertantrums.co.uk/find-us/): address, map and directions; near Bond Street and Oxford Circus stations

## Sunday bottomless brunch
Every Sunday from 12pm. £40 per person: choose a starter, main and dolce, with 90 minutes of bottomless drinks — Aperol Spritz, prosecco, margaritas, beers, and white, red or rosé wine. Starters: trio of butters with baked pinsa romana, burrata & miso honey, capocollo. Mains: pinsa romana (prosciutto, or camembert di bufala & confit tomatoes), creamy mushroom pasta, pesto & confit tomato pasta, smashed cucumber salad with burrata, gorgonzola, pear & wild rocket salad. Dolce: matcha tiramisu, cannoli. Book via OpenTable: https://www.opentable.com/r/temper-tantrums-london

## Private hire
Temper Tantrums takes private parties, corporate events, birthdays, launches and full-venue takeovers, including Christmas parties. Enquiries via the form at https://tempertantrums.co.uk/events/ (capacities and minimum spends on request).

## Facts
- Address: 94 Wimpole Street, London W1G 0EH, United Kingdom
- Area: Marylebone, West London
- Instagram: @temper.tantrums.london
- Cuisine: Italian with Asian accents; notable dishes include pinsa romana, cicchetti, crostini, pasta (tagliatelle, penne, spaghetti bolognese), salumi and formaggio platters, breakfast bruschetta and cornetti
- Opening hours: Mon-Fri 8am-11pm; Sat 8am-midnight; Sun 8am-8pm. Breakfast from 8am, lunch from 12pm, dinner from 5pm; bottomless brunch Sundays from 12pm
- Reservations: https://www.opentable.com/r/temper-tantrums-london (OpenTable); walk-ins also welcome
- Price range: ££
